description: www.EnergyStorage.ninja is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Storage technology assumptions and projections", published or maintained by EnergyStorage.ninja (publisher inferred from the link). A model for Levelized Cost of Storage (similar to LCOE) for 9 technologies in 12 applications from 2015 to 2050 with the option to vary own assumptions on costs, performance parameters and application requirements: www.EnergyStorage.ninja. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Storage technology assumptions and projections" lists it. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support storage technology assumption inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
